beats.label: S1 · Three strangers, one podcast
beats.text: Charles, Oliver and Mabel meet in an Arconia elevator with Tim Kono; hours later Tim is dead. Police call it suicide, so the three start a podcast to prove otherwise.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces the trio, the podcast conceit and the Arconia as a crime scene - the frame everything else hangs on.

beats.label: S1 · Mabel's hidden history
beats.text: Mabel is revealed to have known Tim since childhood; a decade earlier her friend Zoe died on the Arconia roof, and Tim's silence about a second attacker broke them apart.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Recasts Mabel as personally tied to the victim and to the building's past, motivating why she cannot walk away from any of it.

beats.label: S1 · The sponsor is 'Angel'
beats.text: Podcast sponsor Teddy Dimas is exposed as 'Angel', the black-market fence Tim was trying to bring down, drawing his son Theo into the case too.
beats.whyLoadBearing: First suspect flip; wires the Dimases into both the Tim case and Zoe's long-ago death.

beats.label: S1 · Zoe's real killer
beats.text: Flashbacks show Theo accidentally pushed Zoe from the Arconia roof, and Teddy silenced Tim to bury it. But Tim's autopsy proves poisoning, clearing the Dimases of his murder.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Resolves the ten-year-old wound while proving the actual killer is still at large, forcing the trio back to square one.

beats.label: S1 · Jan the bassoonist
beats.text: Charles's girlfriend Jan - Tim's spurned lover - is unmasked as the killer; she poisons Charles and tries to gas the Arconia before Mabel knocks her out.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Closes the Tim Kono case and hands Charles his first serious romantic wound, leaving the trio poised to celebrate.

beats.label: S1 · Framed over Bunny's body
beats.text: A text lures the trio out; they run back and find Mabel kneeling over board president Bunny Folger, stabbed dead. All three are arrested as the Arconia watches.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The launchpad: someone has framed the trio for exactly the kind of murder they solve, resetting them from investigators to prime suspects.

cliffhanger.text: The Tim Kono case is closed, but the trio is walked out of the Arconia in handcuffs, framed for the murder of board president Bunny Folger by an unseen enemy.
questions: Who murdered Bunny and set the trio up to take the fall?
What did Bunny know or possess that got her killed?
Can the trio clear their own names while their podcast rivals brand them murderers?

characters.name: Charles-Haden Savage
characters.line: Misanthropic semi-retired star of the 90s cop show Brazzos; the trio's straight man, freshly heartbroken after nearly being poisoned by his girlfriend.

characters.name: Oliver Putnam
characters.line: Broke, theatrical Broadway director whose podcast turned his tenancy into a bidding war and reopened his shaky bond with adult son Will.

characters.name: Mabel Mora
characters.line: Young artist renovating her aunt's Arconia apartment; the guarded one whose childhood ties to Tim broke the case wide open.

characters.name: Bunny Folger
characters.line: Arconia board president who spent the year trying to evict Oliver, stabbed dead in her apartment on the trio's celebration night.

characters.name: Cinda Canning
characters.line: Star true-crime podcaster the trio idolised; she mocked their show on Fallon and now hunts them as her next subject.

characters.name: Detective Williams
characters.line: NYPD detective on maternity leave, quietly rooting for the trio and slipping them evidence when the official case closed.

characters.name: Teddy Dimas
characters.line: Oliver's old associate and podcast sponsor, exposed as jewellery fence 'Angel' but cleared of Tim's murder.

characters.name: Theo Dimas
characters.line: Teddy's deaf son, who accidentally killed Zoe on the Arconia roof a decade ago and was silenced by his father ever since.

beats.label: S2 · Cleared but hunted
beats.text: The trio is released for lack of evidence, but rival podcaster Cinda Canning launches a series casting them as guilty, forcing them to solve Bunny's murder themselves.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes the season's central pressure and reroutes the trio from suspects to their own investigators.

beats.label: S2 · The stolen painting
beats.text: Bunny gasped 'Savage' and '14' before dying. The trio finds a painting missing from her apartment hanging on Charles's own wall, tying his family to her past.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Anchors the whole mystery in Charles's father's history and gives every subsequent lead a physical MacGuffin.

beats.label: S2 · Mabel and Alice
beats.text: Mabel is pulled into a downtown art scene by gallerist Alice, sparking a romance the others soon suspect could tie Alice to Bunny's murder.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Puts Mabel's judgement on trial with her friends and gives Mabel her first real life outside the Arconia.

beats.label: S2 · Bunny's last day
beats.text: Flashbacks show Bunny reversed her retirement, blocking successor Nina Lin's plans; the trio realises a simple kindness could have saved her that night.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Turns Bunny from cardboard obstacle into a person the trio actually failed, colouring every choice they make from here.

beats.label: S2 · Kreps unmasked
beats.text: Mabel is stabbed on the subway; during a citywide blackout she spots glitter on Detective Kreps - the very cop leading the investigation - and realises he was her attacker.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Reveals the police itself has been compromised, pushing the trio to trap the mastermind alone.

beats.label: S2 · The mastermind
beats.text: The trio stages a fake reveal to trap the real killer: Cinda's assistant Poppy is Becky Butler, subject of Cinda's own hit podcast, who killed Bunny to make herself famous.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Closes the Bunny case and humiliates Cinda without destroying her, leaving her as an ongoing professional shadow.

beats.label: S2 · One year on, another body
beats.text: One year later, the case closed, Oliver directs a Broadway play whose lead actor Ben Glenroy suddenly collapses onstage on opening night.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The launchpad: the trio's lives look settled just long enough for a new corpse to drop in Oliver's own theatre.

cliffhanger.text: The trio has cleared its name and Oliver has staged the Broadway comeback of his life. On opening night, his leading man collapses onstage in front of a full house.
questions: Is Ben Glenroy dead - and if so, who wanted him gone?
What darkness lay hidden inside the cast and crew of Death Rattle?
Can Oliver's shot at a Broadway comeback survive its own leading man?

characters.name: Charles-Haden Savage
characters.line: Ex-Brazzos actor, done with Jan and drifting toward his next chapter; still the trio's anxious straight man.

characters.name: Oliver Putnam
characters.line: Broadway director whose new play has just handed him his comeback; freshly aware that son Will is biologically Teddy Dimas's, not his.

characters.name: Mabel Mora
characters.line: Emerging artist and podcaster, cautiously reconciled with girlfriend Alice; still finding footing outside the Arconia.

characters.name: Cinda Canning
characters.line: Publicly disgraced when her assistant turned out to be the killer she built a career on; still the trio's professional nemesis.

characters.name: Detective Williams
characters.line: NYPD ally, back from maternity leave and openly on the trio's side inside the department.

characters.name: Ben Glenroy
characters.line: Lead actor of Oliver's Broadway play who collapsed onstage on opening night.

beats.label: S3 · Ben dies twice
beats.text: Ben Glenroy collapses onstage from apparent food poisoning, revives at the after-party, then plummets down the Arconia elevator shaft to his death that same night.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes both mysteries at once - who poisoned him and who threw him down the shaft - and drops the body in the trio's own building.

beats.label: S3 · Oliver, Loretta and the musical
beats.text: Oliver reworks the doomed play into a musical, Death Rattle Dazzle, and falls in love with actress Loretta Durkin - then finds a scrapbook of Ben clippings hidden in her flat.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets Oliver's most serious romance against the case's central suspicion, entangling his heart with his investigation.

beats.label: S3 · Charles's white room
beats.text: Charles keeps blacking out during his patter song; in one lapse he accidentally proposes to girlfriend Joy, who then breaks up with him over the mess.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Leaves Charles single again and rattled by his own mind at exactly the moment he most needs to trust himself.

beats.label: S3 · Mabel goes solo
beats.text: Newly homeless and drifting from Oliver, Mabel investigates with Ben's documentarian Tobert and briefly starts her own podcast season without the others.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Fractures the trio and introduces Tobert as Mabel's romantic and professional partner going forward.

beats.label: S3 · Loretta confesses to save her son
beats.text: Cornered as prime suspect, Loretta confesses to Ben's murder to protect Dickie - Ben's brother-manager, revealed as her secret biological son.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Explodes the Loretta suspicion arc and gives Oliver the woman he loves willingly walking into prison for her child.

beats.label: S3 · The real killers
beats.text: On opening night the trio corners producers Donna and her son Cliff; Cliff confesses he pushed Ben down the elevator shaft, insisting it was an accident.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Closes the Ben Glenroy case and frees Loretta, letting the trio believe their lives are theirs again.

beats.label: S3 · Sazz is shot
beats.text: Charles's oldest friend Sazz Pataki arrives to celebrate, tells him they need to talk first - and is shot dead by an unseen sniper inside his own apartment.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The launchpad: kills the person closest to Charles with a bullet that may have been meant for him, before he even knows she's dead.

cliffhanger.text: The Ben Glenroy case is closed and Oliver's musical is a hit. Then Charles's best friend Sazz is killed by a sniper's bullet fired into his apartment - meant, it seems, for him.
questions: Who wanted Sazz dead, and was the bullet actually meant for Charles?
What was Sazz about to tell him before she was killed?
Can the trio hunt her killer without tipping the killer off that they know?

characters.name: Charles-Haden Savage
characters.line: Ex-Brazzos actor and podcaster, single after his blackout proposal; unknowingly the target of a sniper in his own home.

characters.name: Oliver Putnam
characters.line: Broadway director whose musical just triumphed; deeply in love with Loretta Durkin and finally at ease with his life.

characters.name: Mabel Mora
characters.line: Podcaster and artist reconciled with the trio; dating documentarian Tobert and rebuilding after losing her apartment.

characters.name: Loretta Durkin
characters.line: Actress and Oliver's partner, revealed as the birth mother of Ben's brother Dickie; briefly confessed to the murder to protect him.

characters.name: Sazz Pataki
characters.line: Charles's oldest friend and stunt double for decades; just shot dead in his living room with something urgent left unsaid.

characters.name: Detective Williams
characters.line: NYPD ally, still the trio's back channel into the department.

characters.name: Tobert
characters.line: Ben Glenroy's former documentarian, now Mabel's boyfriend and podcast collaborator.

beats.label: S4 · Ashes in the incinerator
beats.text: The trio flies to LA for a film adaptation, unaware Sazz is dead. They return to find her ashes in the Arconia incinerator and a bullet hole through Charles's window.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Locates the crime scene in Charles's own home and confirms the killer knew exactly where to shoot from.

beats.label: S4 · The West Tower
beats.text: Convinced the sniper fired from across the courtyard, the trio befriends the West Tower residents and breaks into the apartment of an absent Professor Dudenoff.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Opens the season's whole geographic and human puzzle - the mysterious neighbours and the missing landlord - as the first false lead.

beats.label: S4 · Hollywood shadows
beats.text: Eugene Levy, Zach Galifianakis and Eva Longoria arrive to shadow the trio for the film; producer Bev Melon reveals Sazz feared something on the production itself.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Plants the movie set as the real crime scene and gives the actors licence to embed themselves in the investigation.

beats.label: S4 · Dudenoff was already dead
beats.text: Cornered, the West Tower residents confess they are illegal tenants of Dudenoff, who quietly killed himself and asked them to hide it - erasing the trio's best lead.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Collapses the season's biggest suspect pool and forces the trio to look back at the film crew they had dismissed.

beats.label: S4 · Marshall is Rex Bailey
beats.text: Ron Howard identifies Sazz's dangerous protégé as Rex Bailey; Mabel realises the film's screenwriter Marshall is Rex, who stole Sazz's own script and killed her to bury it.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Names the killer and gives the murder its motive - envy of Sazz's second act as a writer.

beats.label: S4 · Jan finishes it
beats.text: Rex almost kills the trio inside the Arconia before Jan, escaped from prison, shoots him dead from Charles's window - avenging Sazz.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Closes the Sazz case with an old ghost of Charles's own doing the killing, and puts Jan back behind bars.

beats.label: S4 · Wedding, then Lester
beats.text: Oliver marries Loretta; Sofia Caccimelio tries to hire the trio to find her missing husband - hours before they discover doorman Lester drowned in the Arconia fountain.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The launchpad: hands the trio a new client they refuse and a new body they can't, both hinting the Arconia itself is the crime.

cliffhanger.text: Sazz is avenged and Oliver is finally married. The next morning the trio finds Lester, the Arconia's doorman of thirty years, drowned in the courtyard fountain.
questions: What Arconia secret got Lester killed?
How does mob widow Sofia Caccimelio - and her missing husband - connect to their building?
Can the trio investigate the death of one of their own without becoming the next?

characters.name: Charles-Haden Savage
characters.line: Ex-Brazzos actor still mourning Sazz; the film adaptation forced him to reckon with what she meant to him.

characters.name: Oliver Putnam
characters.line: Broadway director, now married to Loretta and buoyantly starting a life with her in New York.

characters.name: Mabel Mora
characters.line: Podcaster and investigator, still apartment-less and living increasingly out of the case.

characters.name: Loretta Durkin
characters.line: Actress; now Oliver's wife after a quiet Arconia wedding.

characters.name: Lester
characters.line: Beloved Arconia doorman of three decades; found dead in the courtyard fountain the morning after Oliver's wedding.

characters.name: Sofia Caccimelio
characters.line: Woman whose husband has vanished; tried to hire the trio at the wedding, hinting the Arconia itself was involved.

characters.name: Detective Williams
characters.line: NYPD ally who quietly helped work Sazz's murder around the FBI's official case.

beats.label: S5 · A finger, not Lester's
beats.text: The trio finds a severed finger at Lester's funeral; Charles checks the body in the coffin and all ten fingers are intact, so the finger belongs to someone else entirely.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Confirms Lester's death was not accidental and hands the trio the physical clue that drives the entire season.

beats.label: S5 · The mobster and the casino
beats.text: Wedding photos link Lester to missing mobster Nicky Caccimelio. Sofia leads the trio to a secret casino under the Arconia; Nicky's body soon surfaces at her family's dry cleaner.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Roots the whole mystery underneath the trio's own building and makes Sofia their reluctant partner rather than a client.

beats.label: S5 · Three billionaires
beats.text: The trio traces the poker room to billionaires Jay Pflug, Bash Steed and Camila White, who buy their podcast's distributor and use it to muzzle the investigation.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets the season's opposition - not one killer but a cartel of very rich people with a legal weapon aimed at the podcast.

beats.label: S5 · Camila's Arconia play
beats.text: Camila is exposed as Nicky's lover and has been quietly buying up Arconia apartments to convert the whole building into New York's first casino, evicting the residents.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Raises the stakes from a murder to the loss of the Arconia itself, uniting the residents around the trio.

beats.label: S5 · Lester's confession
beats.text: The Arconia's new robot doorman replays Lester's last words: he killed Nicky by accident to stop the casino, and had Randall plant the severed finger as a clue.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Rewrites Lester from murder victim to reluctant killer and reframes his death as retaliation for that killing.

beats.label: S5 · Mayor Tillman exposed
beats.text: The finger belongs to Mayor Tillman, exposed as Sofia's secret lover; he killed Lester to bury the affair. He and the three billionaires are arrested and the Arconia is saved.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Closes both the Nicky and Lester cases in one confession and restores the building - the season's real prize.

beats.label: S5 · Cinda at the gates
beats.text: Months later the trio listens to a new Cinda Canning podcast, then finds Cinda herself collapsing dead-eyed at the Arconia gates.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The launchpad: turns the trio's oldest professional enemy into their next possible victim on their own doorstep.

cliffhanger.text: The Arconia is saved and the mayor is in prison. Then the trio finds their long-time rival Cinda Canning dying at the building's front gates.
questions: Who attacked Cinda, and does she survive?
Why did she come to the Arconia after years of enmity?
Is her final podcast a taunt, a confession, or the bait for the next case?

characters.name: Charles-Haden Savage
characters.line: Ex-Brazzos actor and podcaster; slept with mob widow Sofia mid-case and is quietly ageing into his last chapter.

characters.name: Oliver Putnam
characters.line: Broadway director married to Loretta, still directing the trio's investigations as if they were plays.

characters.name: Mabel Mora
characters.line: Podcaster and investigator, freshly reconciled with her long-estranged childhood friend Althea.

characters.name: Loretta Durkin
characters.line: Oliver's wife; her Los Angeles apartment burned down, bringing her back to New York for good.

characters.name: Cinda Canning
characters.line: True-crime podcast queen and professional rival of the trio; found dying at the Arconia gates in the season's final beat.

characters.name: Sofia Caccimelio
characters.line: Widow of murdered mobster Nicky; inherits his fortune and departs for a new life with Lester's widow Lorraine.

characters.name: Detective Williams
characters.line: NYPD ally who helped the trio thread the casino case around the corrupt mayor's office.
